Coral Reef Watch Daily Global 5km Satellite Sea Surface Temperature v3.1 (CoralTemp v3.1)

NOAA Coral Reef Watch Daily Global 5km Satellite Sea Surface Temperature Anomaly (1991-2020 Climatological Baseline). This is a data file of the NOAA Coral Reef Watch Daily Global 5km Satellite Sea Surface Temperature Aonomaly Product derived using a standard daily climatology of 1991-2020 baseline time period.

Sea Surface Temperature Anomaly, NOAA Coral Reef Watch Daily Global 5km Satellite SST
Anomaly (baseline climatology 1991-2020), 2006-present, Daily

A 2D array, in the same size as the data array in the X and Y directions, classifying land, missing, and ice pixels that are all flagged by the same missing_value (specified by the variable attribute _FillValue) in the data array(s), along with water (data) pixels.
